data.name: Khadijaa
data.gender_notes: Khadijaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Exalted, Worshipped, Venerable, Respectable, Admirable, Noble, Elegant, Radiant, Beautiful, Wise, Virtuous, Truthful, Generous, Sincere, Pious, Worshipper of Allah. The name Khadijaa carries the meaning “Elegant, Admirable, Worshipper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khadijaa usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, admirable, worshipper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman of great character and strength, who embodies wisdom, beauty, and piety. The name Khadija is associated with the early wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who supported and encouraged him during the early stages of his prophethood.
data.etymology: Khadijaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegant, Admirable, Worshipper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khadijaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: خديجة
in_arabic.meaning: عروس الرسول، أُم مُحَمَدٍ، تاج العروس، السيدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخديجة هي أُم مُحَمَدٍ بنِ عَبْدِ اللَهِ وَهيَ السيدة التي سُمّيت بالزَينة، وَهيَ الزَينة التي لا زَينة بَعضها. وَهيَ عَروس الرسول، وَكانَ الرسول يُجَرّيها في مَدينَة مَكَة، وَهيَ العَروس التي جاءَت في حَديثِ الرسول: "خديجةً بنتَ خُوَيْلِدٍ أُمّيَ وَأُمّيَ خديجةً". وَهيَ السيدة التي نَقلها الرسول في حَديثِهِ: "خديجةً لَم تَزَل عَلَيهِ رَزِيَةً"

in_urdu.name: خدیجہ
in_urdu.meaning: مُحَمَد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کی اُم، عروس الرسول، تاج العروس
in_urdu.long_meaning: خدیجہ اُم مُحَمَد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم ہیں جنہیں عروس الرسول کہا جاتا ہے، اس نے مُحَمَد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کی شادی کی تھی، اور وہ اُم مُحَمَد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کی ماں ہیں، انہیں تاج العروس کہا جاتا ہے، اور انہیں اسلامی روایات میں بہت عزت دی جاتی ہے

in_english.name: Khadijaa
in_english.meaning: The Prophet Muhammad's wife, the mother of the believers, a perfect example of a woman
in_english.long_meaning: Khadijaa was the wife of the Prophet Muhammad and the mother of the believers. She was a perfect example of a woman, known for her kindness, generosity, and strong faith. Khadijaa played a significant role in the life of the Prophet Muhammad, supporting him and helping him in his mission. She was a source of comfort and inspiration to him, and he often sought her counsel and guidance. Khadijaa is considered one of the most important women in Islamic history, and her legacy continues to inspire and influence Muslims around the world.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khadijja holds great cultural significance in Islamic history as she was the first wife of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the mother of his youngest children. She was a successful businesswoman and provided financial support for the early Muslim community. Her status as a successful businesswoman and a devoted wife and mother has made Khadijja an influential figure in Islamic history and an inspiration for Muslim women today.
data.spiritual_significance: Khadijja's name reflects her high status in both the secular and the spiritual worlds. Her name signifies attributes that are highly valued in Islam, such as truthfulness, wisdom, piety, and generosity. Khadijja's devotion to Allah and her support of the Prophet Muhammad during his early years as a prophet demonstrate her role as a faithful and devoted servant of Allah. Khadijja's life serves as an example of a righteous and successful woman in both her personal and professional life, inspiring Muslims to strive for excellence in all aspects of their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Elegant, Admirable, Worshipper" symbolizes Exalted, Worshipped, Venerable, Respectable, Admirable, Noble, Elegant, Radiant, Beautiful, Wise, Virtuous, Truthful, Generous, Sincere, Pious, Worshipper of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khadijaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of elegant, admirable, worshipper.
